description: Get CoinGecko watchlist rankings and snapshots, or market-level signals, for coins and narratives, plus CoinGecko trust-score rankings for exchanges. Measures no site visits or web traffic.

sub.description: Market dataset to return. Required when mode=market; ignored by other modes.

tf.description: Requested history lookback for snapshots. The route clamps to available history when the requested range is unavailable.

name: get_web_traffic

attentionScore.description: Attention score, 0-100: for coins and narratives the log-scaled CoinGecko watchlist count, min(100, 15 x log10(watchlist users / 2)); for exchanges CoinGecko's spot trust score x 10, a venue-quality rating, not attention or traffic (an exchange CoinGecko does not rate is not ranked). No web-traffic measure enters it. Coin and narrative snapshots are restated on this formula from their stored watchlist count (null when none is stored): the stored scores before 2026-09-27 used an older formula (search interest plus watchlist users) and stepped from about 52 to about 91 across 2026-09-26/27.

sentimentUp.description: Share of CoinGecko sentiment votes that are bullish, 0 to 1 (0.72 is 72%); null when there is no vote sample for the entity. CoinGecko publishes no vote count, so a few votes can read 0 or 1.

watchlistUsers.description: CoinGecko portfolio watchlist count; null when CoinGecko sent no count for the coin (never 0).

attention_score.description: The attention score as in the rankings (see attentionScore). Exchange snapshots carry trust score x 10, restated from the stored trust score and rank (rows written before 2026-10-31 stored none), and null when CoinGecko does not rate the exchange.

community_score.description: Exchanges only: CoinGecko's spot trust score (0-10). Null on narrative rows (their mindshare is `mindshare`) and on coin rows (CoinGecko deprecated the score).

mindshare.description: Narrative rows: the narrative's mindshare, 0 to 1 (0.3573 is 35.73%). Null on exchange and coin rows.

public_interest_score.description: Per entity type: exchanges, CoinGecko's trust-score rank (1 = best; null when CoinGecko does not rate the exchange, e.g. Deribit's trust 0 with no rank); narratives, the mindshare watchlist score; coins, null (deprecated).

sparkline.description: URL of CoinGecko's sparkline SVG image; null when CoinGecko sends none.
URL of CoinGecko's sparkline SVG image; null when CoinGecko sends none.

WebTrafficUnavailableMarket.description: Empty degraded market payload returned when persistent and memory caches are both unavailable.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.
